The proposed answer of 500 is incorrect.

Jim walks the diagonal: √(300² + 400²) = √250000 = 500 feet.

Martha reaches the opposite corner by walking one length and one width: 300 + 400 = 700 feet. The solution wrongly adds an extra 300-foot side and gets 1000 feet.

The difference is 700 − 500 = **200 feet**.
